preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input `root` must be either a `TreeNode` object or `None` (empty tree).

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, TreeNode) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root])
preconditions.description: Every node in the tree must be a valid `TreeNode` object with `val`, `left`, and `right` attributes.

preconditions.expression: all(node.val == int(node.val) for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root])
preconditions.description: Every node's `val` must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum_path(root, path) for path in get_all_leaf_to_root_paths(root))
postconditions.description: The returned value is the maximum sum of any path from a leaf to the root, where `sum_path(node, path)` is the sum of node values along `path`, and `get_all_leaf_to_root_paths(root)` returns all leaf-to-root paths in the tree.

postconditions.expression: return_value == root.val if root and not root.left and not root.right else return_value
postconditions.description: If the tree has only one node (root), the result is the root's value.

postconditions.expression: return_value >= sum(node.val for node in path) for path in get_all_leaf_to_root_paths(root)
postconditions.description: The returned value is at least as large as the sum of every leaf-to-root path in the tree.
